answer: Anchor each identity to a river gauging station: every epoch the gauge signs a nonce-stamped flow-rate reading, checked against upstream rainfall and neighbouring gauges. A wandering channel shifts, but a gauge's rating curve is unique to its bend and bed, so a hundred puppets sharing one station report one identical hydrograph and collapse to a single vote, their bond burned. Forging a hundred votes means buying and maintaining a hundred real gauges across a hundred catchments split by ridge lines, each paying calibration visits and flood repairs. An honest agent lets its river speak once.
